title: Volume 1 Chapter 3: Pedicure 3
content: A chic bikini with frills? Something like that. I honestly don’t know anymore.
Sayori continued to try on swimsuits, but it was hard for a healthy boy to look directly at a beautiful girl in a swimsuit of the same age.
Moreover, for some reason, most of the swimsuits Sayori chose were separates or bikinis.
It was probably because her tail extended from her waist. One-piece swimsuits might not be a good match for her.
(Speaking of which, she often wears crop tops.)
Is that because if she doesn’t expose her waist, her tail has nowhere to go and it’s uncomfortable?
The reason was unclear, but anyway, the swimsuits Sayori chose were all flashy and revealing.
While it could be said that they were very gal-like, it was still quite difficult for me to find a place to look.
“Azuma-kun, give me your opinion too! I mean, look over here properly!”
Sayori complained again while wearing another flashy bikini.
“Even if I look, I won’t understand…”
It was completely obvious that I was averting my eyes.
For now, it seemed that Sayori's fashion show had come to an end. She casually announced, “None of them felt quite right,” as she returned to her uniform.
After trying on so many, she hadn’t found anything she liked.
Girls’ clothing, especially swimsuits, seemed to have so many options in terms of color and design, it must be tough.
“Hey, there seems to be a section for demi-human swimsuits over there—”
I pointed out a corner in the store.
If she was struggling with her tail, I thought there might be designs suitable for her.
“Oh, that? The designs aren’t very cute, and there aren’t many new arrivals. Today, I’m going with this one.”
“I-I see.”
“If it’s not a new brand, it might get a no for the shoot, right?”
Now that I think about it, the shoot was for a fashion model.
It really seemed like there was a lot to consider.
I walked around the store again with Sayori as she continued to choose swimsuits.
Even though I was with Sayori in the women’s swimsuit section, it felt a bit awkward to be the only guy there.
“Hey, Azuma-kun, what kind of swimsuits do you like? Which one do you want me to wear?”
“How many times are you going to ask…?”
“Because it gives me a starting point for choosing, right? Don’t you have any preferences? Like, ‘I like this kind of swimsuit!’ or ‘This nail would go well with that!’”
“Nails… huh.”
I looked at the swimsuits lined up in the store.

What came to mind were the nails I had done for Sayori so far. The first nail chips I made, and the first nail polish I completed after much effort. There were also the paints Sayori had brought and various examples from magazines.
In my mind, I started to think of combinations of swimsuits and nails with Sayori as the model.
Even though there were many swimsuits and nails, the combinations must number in the thousands.
But well, model building was similar.
For this part, for this robot, what color would suit it? I always considered the shape and the color of the paint to find the most striking combination.
As I mentally dressed Sayori in various swimsuits and changed her nails, I found myself staring intently at one swimsuit.
“Ah—”
“Is this one good? Do you like this kind?”
“Uh!”
Before I could say anything, Sayori immediately jumped on it.
“N-No… I just thought there was a polish that would match this.”
“Yeah, yeah! That sounds good, it’s flashy and cute!”
So for Sayori, flashy equals cute, huh?
Sayori took the hanger and held it up to her body.
“Oh, but the sides are strings.”
“Ugh.”
Crap, I had only thought about the color. I just thought it should be a color that wouldn’t get overshadowed by her nails.
The fluorescent vivid pink bikini would probably suit Sayori, who was flashy by nature, but it was quite a daring type of swimsuit with both the top and bottom held together by strings.
“Well, whatever, I’ll go with this one♪”
“W-Wait… is that really okay? This one!”
“Huh? Isn’t it cute? Plus, since you picked it, I want to wear it♪”
So it’s going to be considered my choice, huh?
“This swimsuit is a new brand, so it’s okay for the shoot! Perfect, as expected of Azuma-kun!”
“O-Okay…”
Sayori, with a big smile, ended up buying the daring swimsuit.
For a gal, it must be within the acceptable range of exposure. But it was painful to be thought of as the one who chose it.
The damage of being seen as a pervert by a girl is immeasurable for a high school boy. Sayori herself was all fired up about buying it, so she didn’t seem to care—right?
“I’m glad it was decided so easily♪”
With the bag containing the swimsuit, Sayori was all smiles.
Her standard for “easily” seemed different from mine. We had just spent about an hour doing a fashion show.
“Alright, let’s head to the garage and get started on that pedicure!”
“W-Wait, right now…?”
We had already spent time choosing a swimsuit, and I was worried we wouldn’t have enough time to get to the garage—but Sayori seemed completely pumped to go now that she had bought the swimsuit.
As I was pondering what to do, she suddenly said, “Ah, sorry, I have a call… Oh, it’s Mio-chan. I wonder what it is.”
Sayori’s smartphone vibrated.
Holding her heavily decorated phone, Sayori answered the call.
Mio—she was the fashion magazine editor we had talked about earlier.
“Hello, it’s Sayori… Yes, yes… Huh? What!? The meeting was today!? Oh no…”
I couldn’t quite tell what was happening, but she seemed to be panicking.
“I’m really sorry! I’ll dash home right now! Yes! I’ll call you back when I get home! Yes! Yes—sorry, Mio-chan!”
An editor—so she was dealing with an adult, huh?
Sayori spoke to her like she was talking to a friend.
“Sorry, Azuma-kun, I have a meeting with the editor… I have to go home today. Is it okay if we do the pedicure another time?”
“Ah, sure. I have some preparations to do anyway…”
“Okay. Yeah, it’s a bit disappointing, but—see you tomorrow!”
“Yeah, take care.”
Sayori seemed to be in a hurry as she waved goodbye to me and ran off in the direction of the station. Watch where you’re going, or you’ll trip.
Even though I had often come to this mall alone, after Sayori disappeared, I suddenly felt a sense of loneliness, which was strange.
(…Well then.)
As I told Sayori, I needed to prepare.
I walked not to my usual model shop, but to the drugstore. In large drugstores and shops, there’s always a section for manicure supplies.
I knew that the drugstore in this shopping mall had a good selection.
(Let’s look for a paint that matches that swimsuit.)
I began to examine the various nail polishes in the manicure section.
Even though I had been so concerned about how I looked in the swimsuit section, in the equally crowded nail polish section, I felt like I didn’t care what anyone thought.
That was probably because I had a clear purpose.
To show off a pedicure that would match Sayori’s swimsuit.
(Which one should I choose? I had a few in mind, but I’m still struggling.)
I couldn’t really say anything about Sayori’s swimsuit choices.
In the end, I wandered around the drugstore and shops.
Before I knew it, I had spent an hour just thinking about the polish I would use on Sayori.
Now, the next day.
“I’m coming in!”
As I was preparing in the garage, Sayori cheerfully burst in.
“Ah, how was the meeting…? Was it okay?”
“Yeah! It was about the swimsuit, and when I sent Mio-chan the photo of me wearing it, she gave me the thumbs up right away! It was over in a second!”
“R-Really?”
She must have tried on the swimsuit she just bought at home.
Imagining Sayori in a swimsuit at home made me involuntarily shake my head. Today, we were supposed to be doing a pedicure.
“So? Have you decided what you want to paint?”
“Hmm…”
Sayori pondered.
“I don’t have a specific idea yet! The shoot is next week, so I need to decide quickly… Oh! What do you recommend, Azuma-kun?”
“I’ve picked out a few that might match that swimsuit.”
I showed her the ones I bought at the cosmetic shop and drugstore, as well as some that she had given me that seemed just right.
“Hmm, this one won’t work because it’s too similar to what other girls have, and this one isn’t really my style…”
“Is it a problem if it’s similar to what other models have?”
“It’s not an absolute rule, but it can happen that we end up with similar nails. But I want to express my individuality!”
Sayori had been examining the polishes for a while, but eventually…
“I see.”
I nodded. I did have some recommendations, but it couldn’t be helped.
“—Are you angry? I feel like I’m being selfish.”
“It’s a nail for a shoot, so it’s only natural to consider the circumstances of the shoot. In fact, I don’t know about that side of things, so you should think it through properly.”
“Ugh. I’m sorry! I’ll think about it more seriously!”
Sayori saluted sharply, her tail standing straight up.
“For now, how about we do a trial pedicure today?”
“Oh, I think that’s a good idea!”
“Let’s do the base treatment with the grinder first, and if we have time, let’s try painting one type for now.”
“That would be a big help! Thanks!”
I thought it would probably be okay, but Sayori’s nails were a formidable opponent.
It was best to confirm that I could paint them properly in advance.
“Okay, let’s sit on the sofa for now—”
“Alright!”
I couldn’t have Sayori put her feet on my usual work desk (and that position was precarious for various reasons), so I had her sit on the sofa.
I placed a step stool I found in the back warehouse in front of her, where she sat.
“Put your feet up here.”
“Got it!”
Sayori took off her shoes and socks and placed her bare feet on the stool.
As expected of a model, her long, slender legs were dazzling. Her skin was pale, showing that she took care of it regularly.
And then, her toenails.
Sayori’s toenails, like her hands, glimmered with a golden sheen, suggesting they contained metallic particles.
The tips of her nails were slightly sharp. Wait, won’t these poke holes in her shoes?
“How is it? I take pretty good care of my toenails, you know?”
Sayori waved her removed socks around as she asked.
“Y-Yeah… why are your nails so sharp?”
“I think it’s just part of being a dragon? They end up like this on their own. It’s a hassle to buy new socks, and I can’t wear the shoes I like!”
“Being a fashionable dragon is tough, huh…”
“Right!? Azuma-kun! If you’re going to file them, can you make the tips round and cute?”
“Sure, sure.”
I took out the grinder I had prepared.
“Alright, let’s get started.”
I gently placed her foot in my hand to hold it steady.
As I spoke to her, I carefully brought the grinder to the tips of her nails.
“Hmm.”
Sayori let out a breathy sound.
“D-Don’t make weird noises.”
“I’m not! It just tickles!”
“Just hold still…”
“Hmm, I-I’m fine… I’ll get used to it soon…”
Focus, focus!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/JNFeua1.jpeg
To avoid being distracted by Sayori’s voice, I concentrated on her nails. As I applied the grinder, I could see the shavings piling up on the stool.
“Hmm… How’s that? Am I filing them well?”
“Yeah, no problem.”
As expected, it wasn’t much different from filing her hands.
Sayori occasionally squirmed as if it tickled, but I kept my focus on her nails. But her feet were beautiful. There wasn’t a trace of calluses or dirt.
I could see a slight scale pattern on her ankles. Aside from the scales and nails, her feet looked just like a human’s.
“Azuma-kun, um…”
“What is it?”
“Is that position uncomfortable for you?”
Caught off guard, I fell silent.
In preparing for the pedicure, I had considered Sayori’s comfort, so I had brought the stool, but the height of the stool was a bit too low for the work.
As a result, I had to kneel in front of the stool, bending my back quite a bit to work.
To be honest, it was quite a tough position. My weak legs were already trembling from the strain.
“Azuma-kun? You went quiet… Are you okay?”
“I-I’m fine.”
“Your voice sounds strained!?”
I hadn’t been able to hide it. Sayori raised her voice in concern.
I only needed to straighten my back a bit, but if I did that, I would inevitably see more of her skirt.
With how short Sayori’s skirt was, if I looked up while kneeling at her feet, it was obvious what would happen. It was clear as day.
“You can change to a more comfortable position, you know? It must be hard to paint like this. If you want, you can use your usual work desk…”
“It’s bad manners to put my feet on the desk…”
“Then how about this? You sit on a chair, and I’ll put my feet on your lap!”
I had thought of that too.
Sayori would have to raise her feet higher than now, but it would significantly reduce the strain of the work. It would probably be easier than the current position, but—
“Hey, if I do that… you know it’ll be visible, right?”
I had intended to keep that to myself.
But since Sayori didn’t seem to have any sense of modesty, I ended up saying it out loud.
“Huh? Visible…?”
Sayori tilted her head in confusion.
When I inadvertently looked up, there was Sayori smiling mischievously at me.
“Oh, I see… So that’s what you were worried about.”
“N-No, that’s not—”
“Azuma-kun is so lewd♪”
I was completely being teased.
“W-Why would I be worried about that?”
“Ahaha! You’re flustered! It’s okay, Azuma-kun, I have a perfect countermeasure!”
Sayori stood up from the stool—
And right in front of me, she hiked up her skirt.
“Look!”
“Don’t do that!”
Under her skirt was a daringly cut, glittery pink swimsuit.
“See? I thought you’d definitely see it when I’m getting my pedicure, so I wore a swimsuit!”
“Don’t lift your skirt, you idiot!”
I instinctively grabbed Sayori’s skirt and pulled it down.
From my position, her waist was right in front of me. It was no longer a matter of where to look.
“Why not!? It’s not like I’m wearing underwear! I’m wearing a swimsuit!”
“That’s not the point!”
She completely didn’t understand how boys felt.
Whether it was a swimsuit or not, if a girl lifted her skirt right in front of me, I would panic.
“Wait, Sayori, have you been wearing that swimsuit all day?”
“Huh? Yeah! I came straight here from school!”
So she had been wearing that flashy swimsuit all day.
It wasn’t weird! It wasn’t weird at all! But the immoral situation I was imagining made me bury my head in my hands.
“It’s not any different from when we have swimming class!”
“Even so…”
“Ah, I get it! You think it’s lewd that I’m lifting my skirt, don’t you!?”
“What do you mean you get it!?”
That was true, but it wasn’t quite right.
As I was trying to think of how to convince Sayori, she began unbuttoning her uniform. What the hell was she doing!?
“Wait, wait! Why are you taking it off!?”
“Huh? Well, since I’m under my uniform, it feels kind of abnormal… If I change into my swimsuit, it’ll be fine, right!?”
“It’s not fine…!”
“Ta-da!”
She took off her shirt and inner layer, showing off the glittery pink swimsuit she had on underneath. Listen to me!
When she removed her uniform, I realized just how much her chest stood out. My gaze was drawn to the small triangular fabric covering her chest.
“See? If you see me in a swimsuit, it might give you an idea for the pedicure color, right?”
“Ugh.”
Sayori, with her distance perception all messed up, moved closer to me.
Against the advance of the dragon girl, I, an ordinary high school boy, was powerless.
“Okay! I get it! Just wear the swimsuit, but… don’t get too close!”
“Are you getting all flustered?”
“Shut up!”
“Ahaha, don’t get mad~♪”
Why was she having so much fun being in a swimsuit alone with a guy?
In the end, Sayori shamelessly took off her skirt and changed into her swimsuit.
The sight of a girl in a swimsuit in a dirty garage was honestly incomprehensible. If my dad happened to walk in, what excuse would I even make?
(If I think of it like a race queen—)
That’s right. Sayori is a model.
Race queens are a staple at car races. It wouldn’t be strange for her to be in the garage. No, it would be strange, but I forced myself to think that way to justify the situation.
“Hmm? What’s wrong?”
Sayori was folding her uniform neatly while wagging her tail.
The sight of her neatly folded uniform in the corner of the room felt strange. Plus, the fact that she had taken off her socks made it even more—
(Stop it, stop it, don’t think about it.)
This was all for the pedicure!
